ma.offError(function callback)

Cancel the listening for Mini Program error events.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for reporting Mini Program error events.

Sample Code

let _this;
let test1 = function () {
    console.log('aaa')
    _this.setData({
        detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'offError:ok',
    })
};

Page({
    offError () {
        _this.setData({
            detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'offError',
        })
        ma.offError(test1)
    }
})
